sections.name: Cropped & Short
sections.description: Bobs, pixies and crops - jaw-length and up. A cut stays here when it carries a braid or twist as a detail.

looks.title: Blunt Bowl Micro Bob
looks.text: ultra-blunt bowl-shaped micro bob, heavy straight fringe, geometric one-length line

looks.title: Fluffy Round Bob
looks.text: rounded cheekbone-length bob with fluffy blowout volume, curtain fringe, bouncy soft finish

looks.title: Sharp A-Line Bob
looks.text: angled A-line bob cut short at the nape and sweeping longer toward the jaw, sharp graphic front line

looks.title: Soft French Bob
looks.text: chin-length blunt bob with airy point-cut ends, soft side part, perimeter curved inward beneath the jaw

looks.title: Pin-Pierced Twist Bob
looks.text: chin bob with a small back twist, skewered by one slim ornamental pin with a worked head and a fine drop

looks.title: Alt Shag Bob
looks.text: short shaggy bob with razored layers, choppy bangs, messy piecey crown, undone movement

looks.title: Finger-Wave Vintage Bob
looks.text: chin-length bob set in sculpted finger waves, deep side parting, sleek retro ripples

looks.title: Bandana Pin-Up Bob
looks.text: short bob rolled and set with a folded tied bandana across the crown, retro pin-up shaping

looks.title: Beret-Set Waved Bob
looks.text: chin-length waved bob worn tilted under a soft beret, one curled front piece left loose

looks.title: Headband Bardot Bob
looks.text: chin-length curled bob pushed back with a thin padded headband, soft bump of crown volume

looks.title: Curly Blunt Bob
looks.text: curls cut to one blunt length at the jaw, dense weight through the ends, soft spring lifting off the shoulders

looks.title: Cage-Braid Crown Bob
looks.text: chin bob with a woven open cage braid arcing over the crown from ear to ear, sculpted lattice technique, tucked ends

looks.title: Butterfly-Clip Spiky Bob
looks.text: jawline bob with flipped-out ends, zigzag part, mini butterfly clips scattered at the temples

looks.title: Messy Pixie Muse
looks.text: textured pixie with piece-cut fringe, short razored sides, crown layers lifted into separated points

looks.title: Wet-Look Slick Pixie
looks.text: slicked-back pixie with glossy finish, defined sideburn pieces, sharp exposed hairline

looks.title: Wispy Curtain Pixie
looks.text: longer pixie with elongated curtain bangs framing the cheeks, soft feathered nape, gentle volume

looks.title: Leaf-Filigree Pixie
looks.text: a textured pixie pinned with small enamelled leaf clips scattered back from the temple, each one worked in fine detail

looks.title: Bixie Feathered Crop
looks.text: bob-pixie hybrid with feathered layers, wispy neck length, soft side-swept fringe

looks.title: Slicked Deep-Part Crop
looks.text: short crop combed into a deep dry side part, one side swept flat, smooth polished 1920s lean

looks.title: Tousled Tomboy Crop
looks.text: short layered crop with messy texture, soft micro-fringe, waxed piecey ends, relaxed sporty feel

looks.title: Undercut Buzz Fade
looks.text: short cropped top with a shaved-side undercut and clean tapered fade, bold sharp contrast

looks.title: Beaded-Cap Crop
looks.text: short crop fitted with a snug beaded skullcap of tiny glass rows, a short bead fringe grazing the brow

looks.title: Dewdrop-Bead Crop
looks.text: short wavy crop pinned with a row of linked droplet charms that follow the parting, fine links catching the light

looks.title: Bead-Tipped Twist Crop
looks.text: short natural crop in tidy two-strand twists, each one finished with a small polished bead at the tip

looks.title: Coily Tapered Fade
looks.text: coils kept dense on top over closely tapered sides, a sharp lined hairline, crisp modern shape

looks.title: Curly Cloud Crop
looks.text: short natural coily crop with rounded halo shape, soft defined ringlets, airy volume

looks.title: Flat-Twist Tapered Crop
looks.text: short natural crop set in neat flat twists, rows hugging the scalp, tapered close at the nape

looks.title: Beaded-Loc Short Crop
looks.text: short cropped locs with small metal cuffs and beads threaded onto a few strands, neat tapered shape

looks.title: Beaded-Braid Crop
looks.text: short crop with one thin accent braid at the temple, small wooden beads threaded through it

looks.title: Choppy Bixie Mullet
looks.text: short bixie with a slightly longer choppy nape mullet tail, disconnected piecey layers

looks.title: Afro Rounded Halo
looks.text: short natural afro shaped into a full even rounded halo, dense springy pick-out volume

looks.title: Gemstone Comb Waves
looks.text: short waved bob swept back with a wide comb encrusted in cut-glass jewels of many colors, glinting tucked side

sections.name: Mid-Length
sections.description: Lobs, shoulder cuts and collarbone lengths, worn down.

looks.title: Flipped Sixties Collar Bob
looks.text: a shoulder cut with the ends turned firmly outward, heavy fringe brushed flat, plenty of lift at the back

looks.title: Locs Shoulder Bob
looks.text: shoulder-length locs shaped into a rounded bob line, neat cylindrical strands, clean even weight

looks.title: Layered Collarbone Lob
looks.text: collarbone-grazing lob with soft face-framing layers, middle part, gentle inward flick at the ends

looks.title: Shaved-Temple Wolf Cut
looks.text: a shaggy layered cut with one temple clipped short beneath it, lengths falling long behind, blunt uneven fringe

looks.title: Feathered Shag Curtains
looks.text: mid-length feathered layers with sweeping curtain bangs, 70s-inspired flippy movement

looks.title: Messy Braid-Tucked Wolf
looks.text: a choppy layered mid cut with two small plaits worked back from the temples, the rest left deliberately rough

looks.title: Textured Wolf Shag
looks.text: mid-length wolf cut with heavy choppy layers, shaggy crown volume, wispy curtain fringe

looks.title: Layered Pin Cluster Lob
looks.text: a collarbone lob with a cluster of slim pins set in a row above one ear, the layers left soft beneath

looks.title: Curly Wolf Shag
looks.text: heavily layered curls shortest at the crown and long at the nape, shaggy movement throughout, choppy curled fringe

looks.title: Voluminous 60s Flip
looks.text: shoulder-length hair with a teased bouffant crown and ends flipped sharply outward, retro bombshell shape

looks.title: Floral-Crown Waves
looks.text: shoulder-length soft waves worn under a small dried-flower crown, loose ethereal face frame

looks.title: Coily Curtain Fringe
looks.text: dense shoulder-length coils cut into a flared silhouette, shorter crown layers, rounded ends widening above the shoulders

looks.title: Coily Shoulder Bloom
looks.text: dense coils cut to widen at the shoulder, shorter pieces lifting at the crown, the pattern left fully open

looks.title: Beachy Boho Waves
looks.text: shoulder-length waves shaped in alternating bends, loose middle part, broken ends spread into irregular sections

looks.title: Blunt Shoulder Cut
looks.text: sharp one-length shoulder cut, sleek middle part, straight glassy finish, heavy weighted ends

looks.title: Curtain-Bang Collar Cut
looks.text: a blunt collarbone cut with a long parted fringe sweeping either side of the face, softly stacked through the back

looks.title: Hair-Slide Shoulder Tuck
looks.text: a shoulder cut with one side caught back by a wide worked hair slide, the other left to fall across the cheek

sections.name: Long & Flowing
sections.description: Worn down and long - waist, hip and past.

looks.title: Deep-Layered V-Cut
looks.text: extra-long hair cut into a dramatic pointed V-shape at the back with long face-framing layers, flowing taper

looks.title: Butterfly-Clip Blowout
looks.text: long layered blowout with flipped ends, pastel butterfly clips on both sides, airy curtain bangs

looks.title: Coily Waist Fall
looks.text: coily length worn loose to the waist in a dense even cloud, defined spirals throughout, soft weight through the ends

looks.title: Puffed Coily Waterfall
looks.text: long coily hair picked out into a huge cascading puff falling past the shoulders, dense springy coils, curly-coily volume

looks.title: Coily Side Sweep
looks.text: coily lengths swept over one shoulder and pinned at the opposite temple, dense spring at the crown, soft asymmetric drape

looks.title: Big Bouncy Ringlets
looks.text: long tight defined ringlet spirals with dense springy bounce all over, full romantic volume

looks.title: Voluminous Ballgown Curls
looks.text: long spiral curls set in broad vertical sections, raised crown, layered lengths cascading in widening tiers

looks.title: Velvet-Headband Curls
looks.text: long soft curls pushed back with a wide velvet headband, root volume, loose flowing tendrils

looks.title: Crimped Festival Waves
looks.text: long hair set in dense zigzag crimped texture from root to tip, center part, voluminous festival lift

looks.title: Soft Mermaid Waves
looks.text: waist-length loose waves with glossy texture, middle part, face-framing strands, dreamy flowing finish

looks.title: Pearl-Pin Deep Waves
looks.text: long glossy waves with a deep side part, scattered pearl pins along one temple, soft face frame

looks.title: Wildflower Meadow Waves
looks.text: long loose waves woven with scattered tiny wildflowers and thin trailing grasses across the crown, soft meadow drape

looks.title: Blunt Waist Hemline
looks.text: long hair kept one solid length to the waist, the perimeter cut level, a deep side parting, heavy even fall

looks.title: Deep Side-Part Cascade
looks.text: long silky straight hair with a dramatic deep side part, one-shoulder sweep, glossy liquid finish

looks.title: Hime Straight Cut
looks.text: long straight hair with cheekbone-length hime sections framing the face, blunt straight fringe

looks.title: Hair-Ring Sidelock Fall
looks.text: very long straight length with slim metal rings spaced down one forward section, the rest hanging plain

looks.title: Blowout Princess
looks.text: long bouncy blowout with big rounded layers, curtain bangs, glossy voluminous finish

looks.title: Fluffed Two-Side Fall
looks.text: very long soft length with a small section caught up on each side, fringe swept across, airy through the ends

looks.title: Long Feathered Layers
looks.text: long face-framing feathered layers with a flicked 70s shape, airy movement, deep side sweep

sections.name: Ponytails & Tails
sections.description: Gathered and tied - high, low and to the side. Braided ponytails live here too, not under Braids.

looks.title: Cuffed Box-Braid Pony
looks.text: shoulder box braids gathered into a mid ponytail, metal cuffs sliding along several of them

looks.title: Lush Braided Tail
looks.text: a thick plait worked loose and pulled wide along its whole length, gathered high so it falls full behind

looks.title: Ribbon-Braid Ponytail
looks.text: long high ponytail with a loose braid down the length, a satin ribbon woven through, lifted crown

looks.title: Spiky Short Tails
looks.text: two short high tails with blunt spiked ends, cropped fringe split into narrow points, sharply lifted crown

looks.title: Flower-Tie Twin Tails
looks.text: two tails set behind the ears, a fabric bloom closing each band, small buds pinned along the parting

looks.title: Twin Dutch Pigtails
looks.text: medium hair in two raised dutch braids running to low pigtails, neat scalp rows, sporty symmetry

looks.title: Comet-Tail Wrap Pony
looks.text: sleek high ponytail wrapped tightly at the base, flaring into a long trailing curled tail

looks.title: Low Sleek Pony
looks.text: long straight hair in a low sleek ponytail, smooth middle part, clean minimal drape

looks.title: Low Twin Tails
looks.text: two low tails tied directly behind the ears, smooth center part, equal lengths brought forward over the shoulders

looks.title: Charm-Wrap Side Pony
looks.text: long hair swept into a low ponytail over one shoulder, a fine charm chain wrapped along the length, soft crown

looks.title: Pearl-Chain Low Tail
looks.text: a low gathered tail with a strand of pearls wound down the first few inches, the rest left smooth

looks.title: Branch-Pinned High Tail
looks.text: a high gathered tail with slim cast twigs pinned at the base, fine leaf charms scattered into the length

looks.title: Wavy Bubble Tail
looks.text: a long wavy tail bound at even intervals so it swells between each tie, soft rounded segments, smooth gathered crown

looks.title: Curly Side Tail
looks.text: curls swept low to one side and tied behind the ear, the length spiralling over the shoulder, soft lift across the parting

looks.title: Sidelock Drill Tails
looks.text: a long corkscrewed section left down at either cheek, the rest swept up and away from the face behind them

looks.title: Coily High Pony
looks.text: dense coily lengths gathered into a high round tail, the base bound smooth, soft spring lifting through the body

looks.title: Coily Ribboned Tail
looks.text: a low coily tail bound in a wide grosgrain ribbon, the coils fanning wide below the tie, soft weight through the length

looks.title: Bow-Tied Twin Drills
looks.text: two high tails wound into firm spiral columns, a wide bow fastened at each base, blunt fringe left level

sections.name: Braids & Plaits
sections.description: Plaited, woven and twisted length worn down, including rope twists. Pinned-up twists are under Buns & Updos.

looks.title: Long Waist Locs
looks.text: waist-length locs worn loose down the back, uniform rope-like strands, natural weighty movement

looks.title: Wire-Wrapped Rope Twist
looks.text: medium rope twist bound at intervals with fine silver wire wrapped into neat ribbed bands, sculptural corded length

looks.title: Side-Swept Rope Twist
looks.text: hair gathered to one side and wound into a soft rope, the twist resting over the shoulder, loose crown

looks.title: Twisted Milkmaid Braids
looks.text: two braids taken up and over the head and pinned opposite, soft escaped strands, easy pastoral shape

looks.title: Shoulder Box Braids
looks.text: shoulder-length box braids parted into a neat grid, worn loose with a few swept forward

looks.title: Chain-Laced Basket Braid
looks.text: hair woven into a flat basket-braid panel with a fine jewelled chain laced through the weave, small drops at each crossing

looks.title: Twin Waterfall Braids
looks.text: two braids run back from either temple and meet behind, dropped strands falling through both, length loose below

looks.title: Beaded Twin Plaits
looks.text: two plaits falling forward with small wooden beads threaded down each, a clean centre parting

looks.title: Chain-Threaded Plait
looks.text: a thick plait with a fine chain woven through every crossing, the links catching along its length, bound close

looks.title: Curly Fishtail
looks.text: loose curls woven into a soft fishtail, the plait left slack so each curl keeps its shape, wispy pieces pulled free

looks.title: Curly Ribbon Plait
looks.text: a loose plait of soft curls with a narrow satin ribbon woven the whole way down, the bow tied at the taper

looks.title: Coily Rope Braid
looks.text: coily hair drawn into one thick rope plait down the spine, the pattern still visible along every turn, blunt tapered close

looks.title: Coily Twin Plaits
looks.text: two chunky plaits starting high and falling forward, coil texture swelling between each cross, soft frizz left at the parting

looks.title: Cascading Braid Ladder
looks.text: a long central braid with many small braids branching off it like rungs of a ladder down the back, intricate woven grid

looks.title: Fishtail Rope Braid
looks.text: long single fishtail braid with a fine woven herringbone pattern down the back, softly loosened

looks.title: Loose Side Braid
looks.text: long hair gathered into a relaxed side braid, softly pulled-out pieces, gentle undone drape

looks.title: Nordic Warrior Braids
looks.text: long hair with tight raised cornrow-style braids gathered from the crown into a trailing back plait, shaved-look sides

looks.title: Snow-Queen Frost Braid
looks.text: long side braid built from tight overlapping sections, sharply pulled edges, fine flyaways tracing a crisp tapered silhouette

looks.title: Twin Long Braids
looks.text: two long even braids parted down the center, tight neat plaiting, sweet symmetrical drape

looks.title: Wednesday Twin Plaits
looks.text: two long tight low braids framing the face, blunt straight fringe, severe gothic drape

looks.title: Beaded Long Braids
looks.text: long thin braids all over threaded with rows of colorful beads that clink at the ends, center part

looks.title: Bow Space Braids
looks.text: two long loose braids with small ribbon bows tied at the ends, soft flyaways, playful symmetry

looks.title: Coin-Trim Wrapped Braid
looks.text: long side braid tightly wrapped in rows of thin cord, small jingling coins fastened down its length

looks.title: Flower-Vine Fishtail
looks.text: long fishtail braid with tiny fresh flowers and thin vines woven along the plait, garden drape

looks.title: Nordic Cuffed Warrior Braid
looks.text: long trailing back braid fed from tight scalp rows, small metal rings and cuffs clasped along it

looks.title: Starlight Chain Braid
looks.text: long side braid laced with a fine draped chain of tiny star charms glinting along the plait, dreamy trailing wisps

looks.title: Tassel-Wrapped Rope Braid
looks.text: a long rope braid bound at intervals with fine cord, a soft silk tassel swinging from the tie at its end

looks.title: Curly Dutch Twins
looks.text: two dutch plaits raised along the scalp with curls bursting from every crossing, soft tapered tails, tousled finish

sections.name: Buns, Updos & Knots
sections.description: Gathered up and pinned - buns, chignons, knots and twists worn up off the neck.

looks.title: Hairstick Twist Bun
looks.text: hair wound into a smooth vertical bun and held with one long hairstick pushed through, a clean centre parting

looks.title: Coily Pinned Twist
looks.text: coily lengths swept across and pinned into a soft folded twist, the coil pattern breaking the line, loose spirals at the brow

looks.title: Halo Twist Updo
looks.text: medium hair twisted upward from the nape, tucked into a smooth rolled halo around the crown

looks.title: Claw-Clip Twist Updo
looks.text: medium hair twisted up into a loose claw-clip updo, soft falling ends, wispy escaped bangs

looks.title: Kanzashi Blossom Twist
looks.text: medium side twist pinned with a fabric kanzashi flower pin cascading fine silk petal strands, smooth swept crown

looks.title: Looped Bun with Braided Base
looks.text: a high looped bun sitting over a braided base, the tail left short and soft, neat lifted shape

looks.title: Braided Rose Bun
looks.text: a loose braid coiled into itself so the turns read as petals, pinned low at the nape, soft framing pieces

looks.title: Hairfork Knot Crop
looks.text: short crop gathered into a tiny nape knot, pinned with an ornate two-prong fork, small charms dangling

looks.title: Messy Bun with Loose Tendrils
looks.text: hair twisted into a loose low bun, paired tendrils drawn from the temples, crown gently raised, nape wisps released

looks.title: Ribbon-Tied Low Buns
looks.text: two low buns at the nape each tied off with a narrow ribbon bow, soft wisps escaping, gentle balance

looks.title: Curly Low Bun
looks.text: curls gathered into a soft low bun with tendrils escaping at the nape, loose spirals framing the jaw, easy undone shape

looks.title: Curly Twin Buns
looks.text: curls parted centrally and wound into two soft high buns, loose spirals falling free at each side, playful balance

looks.title: Coily Low Chignon
looks.text: tight coils gathered low and folded into a soft dense chignon, a few spirals loosened at the temples, quiet evening shape

looks.title: Coily Topknot Stack
looks.text: coils drawn up into a tall rounded knot balanced high, dense spring packed through the shape, nape left close and neat

looks.title: Messy Bun Undone
looks.text: medium hair folded into a high messy bun, looped ends fanning from the tie, face-framing sections pulled free

looks.title: Sleek Low Bun
looks.text: mid-length hair swept into a smooth low bun, clean center part, sleek gelled edges

looks.title: Space Buns Duo
looks.text: medium hair parted center into two high rounded buns, wispy face strands, playful symmetrical shape

looks.title: Filigree-Comb Chignon
looks.text: a low chignon set with a wide filigree comb of fine scrollwork, small stones held within the metalwork

looks.title: Hairstick Twin Buns
looks.text: medium hair in two low knotted buns, each pierced with a lacquered hairstick, a small bead dangling from every one

looks.title: Pearl-Strung Chignon
looks.text: a low rolled chignon wrapped in fine strands of strung pearls that cross over the coil, one jewelled comb at the side

looks.title: Petal-Bun Blossom
looks.text: low bun arranged into overlapping looped petals like a blooming flower, soft rounded floral shape

looks.title: Scarf-Wrapped Bun
looks.text: medium hair coiled into a low bun, fully wrapped in a printed silk scarf, tied off in a knot

looks.title: Curly Pinned Crown
looks.text: curls swept upward and pinned in a loose ring around the head, spirals breaking the outline, soft pieces at the temples

looks.title: Jeweled-Fork Curl Updo
looks.text: medium curls pinned into a raised clustered updo, ornate jeweled hair fork crossing the center, rounded crown silhouette

looks.title: Coily Bantu Rows
looks.text: coils parted into a neat grid and wound into small standing knots across the head, scalp lines left clean

looks.title: Faux-Hawk Pinup Roll
looks.text: medium hair with the sides pinned in tight against a raised rolled center ridge, bold retro mohawk shape

looks.title: Beaded-Net Snood
looks.text: medium hair gathered into a beaded net snood at the nape, tiny glass beads over the coiled length, vintage caul technique

looks.title: Hairstick Tower Coil
looks.text: long hair wound into a tall stacked coil, skewered by two crossed lacquered hairsticks, beaded drops at their tips

sections.name: Half-Up & Pinned
sections.description: Half gathered, half left down - including half-up braids and twists.

looks.title: Claw-Clip Half-Up Bob
looks.text: short bob pulled into a tiny half-up twist, mini claw clip at the crown, loose front strands

looks.title: Chain-Draped Half-Up
looks.text: medium hair in a half-up twist, a fine draped face-chain looping across the parting

looks.title: Half-Up Bubble Twist
looks.text: medium hair gathered half-up into two rounded pull-through loops, twisted crown sections, loose lengths flowing beneath

looks.title: Twisted Crown Half-Up
looks.text: two front sections twisted back along the temples and joined behind, the rest falling straight and loose, clean simple line

looks.title: Boho Beaded Half-Braid
looks.text: mid-length waves with two thin front braids pulled back, small wooden and pearl beads threaded through

looks.title: Braided Side Half-Up
looks.text: one side plaited from the temple and pinned across the back, the opposite side left sweeping loose, soft uneven shape

looks.title: Cascading Waterfall Braid
looks.text: half-up waterfall braid sweeping across the back with strands falling through like a cascade, long flowing base

looks.title: Braided Bangs Sweep
looks.text: the fringe taken into a thin braid and pinned back at the temple, the rest worn loose and wavy

looks.title: Star-Charm Twin Braids
looks.text: long loose waves with two thin front braids, tiny silver star charms clipped at the ends, center part

looks.title: Gem-Studded Lattice Fall
looks.text: long hair with an open lattice-braid net laid over the crown, each crossing pinned with a small colorful gem, loose length beneath

looks.title: Half-Up Top Knot
looks.text: the crown section drawn up into a small knot with the ends left spiky, the remaining length worn down, easy casual balance

looks.title: Curly Half-Up Knot
looks.text: the top section of curls twisted up into a small knot, the rest left spiralling loose, soft volume over the brow

looks.title: Half-Up Ribbon Bow
looks.text: the crown section drawn back and tied with a wide soft bow, the length falling straight beneath, sweet simple line

looks.title: Flower Crown Wreath
looks.text: a slim braid worn as a band around the head with small fresh blooms tucked along it, the length loose behind

looks.title: Lace-Ribbon Half-Up
looks.text: long curls styled half-up with a lace ribbon bow at the crown, soft volume, curled front strands

looks.title: Coily Half-Up Puff
looks.text: the top section gathered into a round standing puff, the lower coils left long and open, edges kept soft

looks.title: Bone-Comb Curl Sweep
looks.text: long curls swept diagonally from one temple, wide carved bone comb securing the raised side, spiral lengths cascading opposite

looks.title: Scrunchie Half-Up Waves
looks.text: shoulder-length beachy waves in a half-up loop tied with a padded scrunchie, loose front pieces

sections.name: Fantasy & Ethereal
sections.description: Otherworldly shapes - fae, celestial and storybook. Filed by what the style is, not how it is built.

looks.title: Butterfly-Vine Half-Up
looks.text: medium hair in a loose half-up twist, a thin vine hairpiece trailing behind, dotted with tiny enamel butterflies

looks.title: Mermaid-Scale Braid Net
looks.text: back hair woven into an interlocking lattice net resembling overlapping scales, long free lengths beneath

looks.title: Overgrown Moss Braid
looks.text: thick loose braid entwined with trailing moss and tiny curling tendrils as if left to grow wild, damp forest-floor drape

looks.title: Rapunzel Floor Braid
looks.text: extra-long floor-grazing single braid trailing past the feet, thick even plaiting, soft crown wisps

looks.title: Star-Map Braided Grid
looks.text: scalp braids forming radial lines linked by short cross-braids, star-like nodes at the crown, precise geometric parting

looks.title: Lotus-Pin Coiled Knot
looks.text: a smooth coiled knot set high at the back, one carved lotus pin pushed through it, a few soft strands loose

looks.title: Halo of Tiny Buns
looks.text: a full ring of many small even buns encircling the head like a crown, neat repeating pattern

looks.title: Butterfly-Pinned Twin Tails
looks.text: two long tails set high with enamelled butterfly clips climbing each gather, fine antennae catching the light

looks.title: Sky-High Bubble Ponytail
looks.text: very high ponytail bound at even intervals, each section pulled wide into a rounded bubble, long stacked silhouette

looks.title: Forget-Me-Not Wreath Fall
looks.text: a woven ring of tiny blooms circling the crown, the rest spilling free beneath it, stray petals caught in the sweep

looks.title: Mistletoe Wreath Fall
looks.text: a fine woven wreath of small leaves ringing the crown, long length spilling loose from beneath it

looks.title: Elven Half-Crown Weave
looks.text: intricate thin braids gathered from both sides into a delicate woven half-crown, long flowing lengths below

looks.title: Feather-Pinned Spiral Fall
looks.text: long spirals falling free with slim plumes pinned above one ear, the quills angled back along the curl

looks.title: Angelic Halo Curls
looks.text: extra-voluminous cloud of soft curls forming a wide radiant halo around the face, weightless airy shape

looks.title: Moonlit Circlet Waves
looks.text: medium soft waves under a fine wire circlet, a small crescent-moon charm centered on the forehead

looks.title: Living-Vine Fairy Mane
looks.text: waist-length loose waves woven with tiny leaves and trailing vine strands, wild ethereal drape

looks.title: Crescent Forehead Drape
looks.text: long ethereal waves parted by a delicate chain hairpiece, a small crescent-moon pendant resting on the forehead

looks.title: Crystal Vine Wire Cascade
looks.text: long waves wound with a slim beaded vine that spirals down one side, faceted drops catching at the ends

sections.name: Historic & Regal
sections.description: Period and courtly styles across the centuries, filed by era rather than construction.

looks.title: Court Rolled Twist
looks.text: hair rolled upward against the back of the head and pinned closed, a soft lifted crown, sleek formal line

looks.title: Renaissance Pearl Twist
looks.text: hair drawn back into a low coiled twist, fine pearl strands looped through the coils, soft pieces at the temples

looks.title: Braided Milkmaid Crown
